# Player Earned Elimination

Source: [4814](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4814); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4814-n1"></a>

- Earned Elimination triggers on elimination credit, with Event Player/Attacker equal the credited player and Victim the credited victim.

<a id="wiki-4814-n2"></a>

- Page lists damage, critical-hit, ability and direction context as available.
